services.name: Tennis Camps
services.desc: Red Ball - Ages 5-7 Beginner This clinic introduces kids ages 5-7 to basic tennis swings and hand-eye coordination exercises. Tennis games aim to foster an early love for the sport of tennis! Larger 25% compression balls, mini nets, and a smaller 36’court are used. Orange Ball - Ages 7-11 Beginner/Intermediate This clinic is for students aged 7-11, both beginner and intermediate, who may have progressed through the red ball class. Played on a 60-foot court with 50% compression balls, this clinic focuses on cooperative and competitive play emphasizing body movement, motor skills, and tennis stroke production.
